conflict.description: P037 declares its smooth D6 journals run in P086 bushings, but P086 has ID3.05 (camshaft cross-section) while P098 (ID6.05) is the bushing allocated to the P037 journals. The interface cross-reference is inconsistent.
conflict.reason: The declared interface reference (P037 -> P086) conflicts with the allocated bushing cross-section (P098 ID6.05); the conflict must be flagged, not silently re-mapped.
